name: Lyrical☆Mint
source:
Suddenly Mint visits main character's house asking him to help her store enough energy to return to the devil world. They start practicing every night while keeping their relations secret from protagonist's sister-in-law. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
薄荷突然來到主角家中，請他幫助自己累積足夠的能量，以便返回魔界。兩人開始每晚進行練習，同時向主角的嫂子隱瞞彼此的關係。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
